answer: Every autonomous agent must maintain a locked liability bond of 1,000 units, held by a peer sponsor who accepts full accountability for misbehavior. The network verifier monitors the signal of graph-distance from established nodes to detect sybil clusters at the break of dawn. If a breach is confirmed, the sponsor loses their deposit, which resets the summit of available identities. Honest participants pay 1,000 to remain secure, while 1,000 fakes incur an equal cost per head to hold quorum membership, effectively neutralizing cost-averaging.
